LE'GO Dance Camp 2026 · ID card size, 9 per A4

Eason Chiang

Teams can be typed as "Zombie", "Team Zombie", "Teacher", "Exec" or "DJ". "Team, Name" order works too.

Cards are 54 × 86 mm (standard ID card / lanyard card holder). Each prints 2 mm of extra background past the cut line, so a slightly-off cut won't leave a white edge.

In the print dialog: paper A4, scale 100% (not "fit to page"), and turn on Background graphics.
